rules.title: The resilient parse is the one grammar's AST plus a trivia layer and an offset index, never a second tree
rules.divergesFromPhp: a PHP editor — PhpStorm, Intelephense — carries a parser of its own beside `php`; here the editor parses with the compiler's one grammar, so what the editor accepts and what `nvs check` accepts cannot drift

rules.title: Every token and every trivium, concatenated in offset order, reproduce the file byte for byte
A node the parser invented says so — `MemberName::Missing` and a spanned `ExprKind::Error` — and an empty span is never the signal
The parser always returns a tree, a node it invented says so, and an offset maps to the innermost node even inside a malformed region
rules.divergesFromPhp: an editor over PHP goes dark below the first syntax error until it is fixed; here completion and hover keep working on the well-formed code around it

rules.title: Position encoding is negotiated, every offset conversion lives in `nvs-diagnostics`, and a document's bytes are never normalised
`SyntaxIndex.at(offset)` answers the innermost node and its ancestors, and is rebuilt per analysis
A full re-analysis of a ~1,000-line document stays under a named bound, and the guard is a test rather than an assumption
`nvs ast --json` has a frozen node schema, is resilient by default, and its only type-dependent field is a `secret` literal's placeholder
`nvs-lsp` and `editors/vscode` are one crate and one package that grow in place; no prototype is built to be discarded
`nvs-lsp` is synchronous on `lsp-server` and `lsp-types` — a reader thread, a writer thread, one analysis thread, and no async runtime
Each open document is analysed as its own entry point, with open buffers overlaid on disk, and diagnostics are published only for open documents
A file a program autoloads or requires is analysed through that program's `autoload` map, behind its own declarations and without reporting anything for the borrowed ones

A `Core` class, enum, interface or compiler attribute is declared in a generated stub file the server writes once per version, which is what a jump to a `Core` name opens, and which is read-only and never diagnosed
rules.divergesFromPhp: PhpStorm ships a hand-maintained stub tree for PHP's built-ins; here the stubs are generated from the registry the runtime dispatches on, so a stub cannot say what the binary does not do

rules.title: M4B answers nine standard requests and exactly one of Novis's own, M10 adds eight more on the same test, and that test keeps the list from growing
The first `nvs lsp` answers six requests and two code actions, and nothing else until the workspace index exists
The VS Code client goes as deep as the editor allows, and each feature waits for the language or runtime piece it needs rather than shipping as a stub
A file with a lexer or parser diagnostic publishes those and its declaration diagnostics, and suppresses its own resolution and type diagnostics
rules.divergesFromPhp: a PHP editor's diagnostics come from one pass with no phase to gate, so a mid-statement typo shows every consequence it cascades into

rules.title: `nvs check --json` writes the same diagnostic records the terminal renderer prints, as one `schemaVersion: 1` document
The symbol index covers every file under the workspace folder by default, and `"open"` narrows it to the open documents and their require graph
A code action ships only where its replacement text is already in a diagnostic's suggestions — two at M4B, and no other

An inspection is a code action backed by a diagnostic the checker emits, runs on the resilient tree, and is off by default under `source.fixAll.nvs` so it composes with format-on-save while `nvs fmt` stays layout-only
rules.divergesFromPhp: there is no inspection profile to tune; a fix exists only where a diagnostic already carries its replacement text, and running fixes on save is `editor.codeActionsOnSave`, never part of the formatter

rules.title: An unqualified name that resolves to nothing carries one `use` line per type it could have meant, and the editor offers each as a quick fix
A type name pasted from one file into another brings the `use` line that resolves it, read at copy time from the file it came from
A code action that writes may write only text the type system has already fully determined, and never makes a choice
rules.divergesFromPhp: implement-missing-members copies real signatures instead of guessing at them, and there is no getter/setter generator because property hooks make the pair pointless

rules.title: Rename, organize-imports and auto-import never write a `use` alias: an import inserts the fully-qualified name, and organize-imports only reorders and removes
rules.divergesFromPhp: PhpStorm's auto-import may add `use Foo as Bar` to dodge a clash; here an alias is not a spelling the language has, so the editor cannot write one

rules.title: One editor action rewrites an `array<mixed>` annotation to the type of the array literal that initializes it, and rewrites nothing else
rules.divergesFromPhp: the language never infers an array's type from its literal; the narrowing is an editor edit a person reads in a diff and approves

rules.title: The synthesized element type is the canonical union of the elements' base types, recursed through nested literals and bounded at depth 32
The narrowing action answers from a literal in the same file, or it is not offered: no literal, a `mixed` element, or a no-op each hides it
rules.divergesFromPhp: a value decoded from input stays `array<mixed>` on purpose and gets no offer, where a PHP editor would happily type it from one observed payload

rules.title: The synthesis is one function in `nvs-types` that no compile path calls, so an array literal stays checked against a target and `var` still refuses a bare one
The narrowing action is never registered under `source.fixAll.nvs` and never chases the call sites it affects, because it breaks writes it cannot see
Syntax highlighting is a TextMate grammar and a semantic-token provider, each with its own test, and each must cover what makes Novis not PHP
rules.divergesFromPhp: type annotations sit where PHP has none — parameters, returns, properties, `foreach` bindings, typed locals, inline shapes — so a borrowed PHP grammar mis-colours the largest part of a Novis file

rules.title: Nothing Novis rejects is coloured as though it were valid
rules.divergesFromPhp: a PHP grammar colours `===`, `(int)$x` and `if (...): endif;` as syntax; here they render as body text so the editor never confirms what the compiler refuses

rules.title: Semantic tokens use LSP's standard types plus two modifiers of Novis's own, `tainted` and `secret`, and the client's legend must equal the server's
rules.divergesFromPhp: no PHP tool shows a value's taint at its use sites; here `tainted` and `secret` travel as token modifiers to every use, not only the declaration

rules.title: Both layers ship standard names and no colours: every scope is on the TextMate allowlist, every token type is in LSP's legend, and the extension overrides no theme
Find-references, occurrence highlight, CodeLens, type hierarchy and unused-member dimming are five queries against one workspace index
The editor completes a value only where the compiler already derives it for another reason, never from a convention scan, an annotation dialect or the network
rules.divergesFromPhp: framework-aware IntelliSense built from convention scans, annotation dialects and an `ide.json` patch file has no counterpart; a route name or a directive completes from the table the compiler built, and an ORM column or a view name has nothing to complete from because Novis has neither

rules.title: A bare name is offered every type the registry and the workspace index hold, by short name, and accepting one that needs an import writes its `use` line
A trigger character opens a list only where it finished `->`, `::`, `\`, `$` or `<?`, and `$`, a lone `:` and `<?` each narrow what is offered
Accepting a type writes `Name::` inside an expression and `Name()` after `new`, and the name alone wherever a type or a statement may start
Accepting a method writes `name()` with the cursor inside where it takes a parameter, and a property, constant, case or alias writes the name alone
A completion row shows a member's signature after its name and its type at the right, a type its namespace, and the card is read on resolve for one item
A reserved word is offered only where the token before it and the nodes around it let the compiler accept it
A PHP-name completion item takes one of four shapes, and three of them insert nothing
rules.divergesFromPhp: typing a PHP built-in's name offers an item that may say dropped, waiting on a milestone or undecided and type nothing, rather than inserting the PHP call

rules.title: An inline-HTML region gets the editor's own HTML, CSS and JavaScript services on boundaries the server reports, and the editor's HTML formatter after `nvs fmt`, indented from the Novis code around it
rules.divergesFromPhp: the markup half of a file gets Emmet, tag closing, the colour picker and the HTML formatter as in a PHP editor, but each markup chunk is indented from the `?>` that opened it — the Novis block's depth — rather than from the markup's own nesting alone

rules.title: `.nvst` and `.lspt` get a grammar of their own, with Novis embedded in `--FILE--` and PHP in `--ORACLE--`
An LSP answer is frozen as a `.lspt` case — a document, a `<|>` cursor, a request and its rendering — run by `nvs lsp-test` printing `N passed, M failed`
`--REQUEST--` is one line whose argument set is closed per request, and an unknown request or argument fails the case
`--EXPECT--` is exact and frozen, and every response is rendered by `nvs_lsp::render` so no case invents a spelling
`.lspt` coverage is inferred from the node the cursor resolved to, never declared, and `every_request_answers_every_construct` names each empty cell
Both tiers run on every acceptance sweep: the headless suites with no editor, and the extension-host run in a pinned build with a throwaway profile
Language smarts and formatting of Novis have one implementation each, `nvs-lsp` and `nvs-fmt`, and an editor client holds none of either
rules.divergesFromPhp: PhpStorm's PHP support is a native PSI plugin with its own formatter and refactorings, whereas its Novis plugin is a bridge to the same server VS Code drives, so nothing about `.nvs` is decided in the editor

rules.title: An editor client lives under `editors/<editor>`, outside the Cargo workspace, and is created when its milestone starts rather than scaffolded ahead of it
The VS Code extension is a `vscode-languageclient` shell: it registers `.nvs`, colours from a TextMate grammar until the server answers, and routes everything else to `nvs lsp` and `nvs fmt`
`.nvs` is registered as its own language in every editor, activates nothing on `.php`, and is never handed to a PHP plugin
rules.divergesFromPhp: a `.nvs` file is not a PHP file to the editor, so Intelephense and PhpStorm's bundled PHP support never open it and none of their settings reach it

rules.title: The extension activates on `.nvs` and never claims `.php`
rules.divergesFromPhp: opening a `.php` file gets the PHP extension already installed, not Novis, even though `nvs-syntax` could parse it

rules.title: `language-configuration.json` carries comments, pairs, indentation, folding and a `wordPattern` that includes `$`
rules.divergesFromPhp: double-clicking `$total` selects `$total`; a configuration borrowed from a PHP extension selects `total` and puts every rename-adjacent interaction off by one character

rules.title: Writing a `///` run is the editor's job: `onEnterRules` continues one, a paste provider prefixes one, and neither contributes a name
rules.divergesFromPhp: a PHP editor continues a `/** */` docblock and autocompletes tags into it; here the continuation is a `///` run and there is no tag to complete

rules.title: A setting name and a command id are public API: the roster is frozen, and anything later is added, never renamed
`nvs run` and `nvs test` are Tasks with a `problemMatcher` over the renderer's own format, so a diagnostic is a Problems-panel entry
The extension declares itself a workspace extension, because `nvs lsp` must be the binary next to the code
The extension is `novis-lang.nvs`, language `nvs`, `extensionKind: ["workspace"]`, built as a `.vsix` and published nowhere
The extension ships no `nvs` binary: a missing one is a guided install the user starts, verified against the release's own `SHA256SUMS`

Coverage, server health, profiles and the debugger reach the editor through its own APIs and open formats — `FileCoverage`, `LanguageStatusItem`, DAP's UI, speedscope — and the extension builds none of them
rules.divergesFromPhp: Xdebug's profiler writes cachegrind for KCachegrind or PhpStorm's own viewer; a Novis profile is speedscope JSON and opens in speedscope.app or an embedded view of it

rules.title: The Test Explorer is `nvs test --list` and `nvs test --format=json` projected: the client matches records to items and derives nothing
The AST panel renders `nvs ast --json` for the active file, on the resilient tree by default, and never runs `Core\Ast`
`package-lock.json` is committed; `node_modules/`, `out/`, `.vscode-test/` and `*.vsix` are ignored
PhpStorm drives the same `nvs lsp` and `nvs fmt` through JetBrains' LSP client, and builds no PSI tree, native refactoring or debugger UI until a later decision says so
rules.divergesFromPhp: Reformat Code runs `nvs fmt` with no PhpStorm Code Style page behind it, and PSI-level refactoring, structural search and the native debugger are absent for `.nvs`

rules.title: `nvs dap` is complete without any editor's debugger UI; VS Code's wiring is a descriptor factory and a `launch.json` schema, and PhpStorm's stays deferred
rules.divergesFromPhp: there is no Xdebug-style listener to configure in the editor; the editor points its own debugger UI at `nvs dap` and renders what the adapter reports

rules.title: The debugger UI is only as deep as the capabilities `nvs dap` reports, so the adapter's capability list is the debugger's scope
rules.divergesFromPhp: break-on-uncaught and break-on-thrown are two exception filters rather than PHP's five categories, and a spawned isolate appears as a thread rather than as a second session

rules.title: Nothing but the protocol writes to the server's stdout; logging goes to stderr and `window/logMessage`
On a version mismatch at `initialize` the client says so in the status item and does not start
Every process the extension starts runs from a verified copy of the binary that is never older than the build on disk, so the file the user named is never held
The extension holds no language logic, and its `package.json` dependencies are checked against an allowlist by its own tests
The editor conceals a `secret` value by default, and the ranges come from the language server rather than a client guess
Only the bytes are concealed — a literal token or an interpolation slot, never an identifier or an annotation
A reveal is per range, window-local, and does not survive the editor closing
What the editor's concealment cannot cover is written down, because a redaction trusted past its reach is worse than none
The redaction request is one server's to answer for both editors, but the drawing is per-editor and PhpStorm has none until its plugin lands
`tainted` ships no default editor decoration, and the marker is opt-in
